mechanism: Both drugs can reduce renal blood flow and increase risk of acute kidney injury through different pathways; diclofenac via COX inhibition and dorzolamide via carbonic anhydrase inhibition affecting renal hemodynamics.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, eGFR) and electrolytes regularly; use with caution in patients with pre-existing renal disease or volume depletion; ensure adequate hydration.
